image.name: EdgeConneX
image.description: EdgeConneX is a global data-center developer and operator headquartered in Herndon, Virginia. Founded in 2009, it develops and operates edge, hyperscale, purpose-built and build-to-density facilities for hyperscale, cloud, enterprise, content, network, technology and AI customers. Public materials describe more than 80 operating or developing sites across over 60 markets in more than 20 countries, with over 10 GW of additional planned capacity. EQT Infrastructure IV completed the Providence-led acquisition on November 5, 2020; EQT Infrastructure V joined in 2021, Sixth Street-managed funds completed a minority investment in 2024, and EQT AI Infrastructure acquired a minority interest from EQT Infrastructure IV and V in 2026 while EQT remained the largest shareholder group. Liberty Global fully exited its former minority interest on June 29, 2026. CPP Investments' $1.75 billion commitment supports EQT's broader AI infrastructure strategy but is not disclosed as a separate direct EdgeConneX shareholding. Individual sites, campuses, subsidiaries, AdaniConneX and Chayora are outside this canonical company boundary. No later company sale, EQT exit, Sixth Street exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.

aliases: U.S. Medical Outpatient Facilities Portfolio (Montecito JV)
image.description: Montecito Medical Outpatient Portfolio is the bounded 2025 Project Lotus sale-recapitalization of a national medical-outpatient portfolio. Fengate Asset Management invested through Fengate Infrastructure Fund IV and affiliated entities using FG MNTO I LOTUS, LLC, while Montecito Medical Real Estate retained equity; their percentages are not publicly disclosed. Fengate described 16 facilities in 10 states, while transaction-advisor and trade sources described 18 properties in 11 states totaling approximately 750,000 square feet and a US$323 million recapitalization with US$233 million of financing. The facilities were 100% leased at closing to health systems and physician groups. The record excludes Montecito's enterprise portfolio and Fengate's separate MedCraft/Cleveland Clinic portfolio. No later portfolio sale, owner exit or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

image.name: CleanCapital Holdings, LLC
image.description: CleanCapital Holdings, LLC develops, acquires, owns and operates distributed solar and energy-storage projects across the United States. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, the platform serves commercial, industrial, institutional, utility and public-sector counterparties through contracted clean-energy assets. Generate Capital and CleanCapital established a project-acquisition warehouse in 2017 targeting approximately US$300 million of operating clean-energy assets; this was project-level financing and ownership rather than disclosed corporate equity, and Generate's exact project stake and exit date were not publicly disclosed. BlackRock Renewable Power Group funds made a direct corporate investment in 2019, but that period is historical. Manulife Investment Management made a corporate investment in 2021 through Manulife Infrastructure Fund II and remains the only named current institutional backer. The exact Manulife and former BlackRock percentages are not publicly disclosed. Infranity's January 2026 capital is a holdco debt facility, and no platform sale or signed ownership exit was identified through August 29, 2026.

image.name: Generate–Stem LCR
image.description: Generate-Stem LCR, LLC is a Delaware special-purpose vehicle formed on June 30, 2017 to purchase and own behind-the-meter battery-storage systems supporting Southern California Edison's West Los Angeles Basin local-capacity program. Stem, Inc. holds a 50% Class B non-managing interest and remains the host-facing technology and operating counterparty. Stem's filings describe a two-class structure and its 50% interest, so the Generate-linked Class A managing interest is recorded as an inferred 50%; the exact Generate affiliate and fund are not publicly disclosed. The cited 85 MW / 340 MWh figures are contract and funding ceilings rather than verified deployed capacity. Stem continued to report obligations and repayments for its consolidated SPE program through June 30, 2026, and no sale, transfer, foreclosure, dissolution or signed pending ownership transaction for Generate-Stem LCR was identified through August 29, 2026.

image.name: ACES Delta, LLC
image.description: ACES Delta, LLC is a clean-hydrogen production and underground salt-cavern storage platform in Delta, Utah. The 2019 joint venture is currently owned by Chevron-controlled Magnum Development, LLC as majority owner and Mitsubishi Power Americas, Inc. as minority owner; exact percentages are not publicly disclosed. Haddington Energy Partners III formerly owned the platform indirectly through Magnum and exited that position when Chevron acquired 100% of Magnum in 2023. Haddington ESP I separately manages construction equity in the ACES I project company, while GIC, Ontario Teachers', AIMCo and Manulife are investors in that fund rather than verified direct ACES Delta owners. The first stage comprises 220 MW of electrolysis and two salt caverns supporting more than 300 GWh of storage. All 40 electrolyzers were reported commissioned in the first quarter of 2026, with final start-up still expected later in 2026. No later platform sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

image.description: Direct ChassisLink, Inc. (DCLI) leases and manages marine and domestic intermodal chassis used to move containerized freight through more than 500 U.S. port and rail locations. GIC, OMERS Infrastructure and Wren House Infrastructure completed their joint acquisition on December 13, 2022; public materials identify the consortium as current but do not disclose member percentages, so no equal split is inferred. DCLI's former ownership chain includes Maersk, Littlejohn, EQT Infrastructure and Apollo-managed funds. The production database already redirects the retired duplicate production ID to this canonical company; this proposal also retires the reciprocal Direct ChassisLink, Inc. seed identity. image.name: Milestone Environmental Services
image.description: Milestone Environmental Services is a U.S. environmental-infrastructure platform that owns and operates permitted slurry-injection and engineered-landfill facilities for liquid and solid drilling, completion and production waste. I Squared Capital signed a definitive agreement on July 7, 2026 to acquire Milestone, but the transaction remained pending as of August 19, 2026; I Squared is therefore not shown as a current owner. Individual facilities, wells, landfills and the Milestone Carbon subsidiary are not separate PortCos.

image.name: Zenith Energy Portland Terminal
image.description: Zenith Energy Portland Terminal is a standalone liquid-bulk storage and multimodal fuels terminal at 5501 NW Front Avenue on Portland's Willamette River. The facility connects marine, rail, truck and pipeline logistics and has 1,518,200 barrels of operator-listed storage capacity. It handles renewable fuels, sustainable-aviation-fuel components and blends, biodiesel, aviation gasoline, distillates and crude oil during a permitted transition that requires crude handling and storage to end by October 2027. Warburg Pincus and Kelso & Company acquired the broader Zenith Energy U.S. platform in 2017 and remain the current sponsors while their signed sale of the Portland terminal is pending. I Squared Capital's Energy Transition Fund, through ISQ Springer Aggregator and ISQ Springer Holdings, signed to acquire 100% on December 16, 2025. The required Portland franchise-transfer ordinance remained pending and no legal closing evidence was found through August 19, 2026, so I Squared is not represented as an active owner or assigned an investment year. The Portland terminal is counted as a standalone PortCo; its tanks, docks, pipeline, racks and conversion projects remain subordinate assets.

image.name: Cyntox Biohazard Solutions
image.subsector: Regulated medical waste collection, transport, treatment, and disposal
image.description: Cyntox Biohazard Solutions is a U.S. regulated medical-waste platform providing collection, transport, treatment, disposal and compliance services for sharps, pharmaceutical, pathological and other healthcare waste. The combined Cyntox and AdvoWaste operations serve thousands of physician offices, hospitals, ambulatory centers, dental and veterinary clinics, laboratories and long-term-care facilities across 26 states, with identified treatment facilities in Newton, New Jersey and Indianapolis. Igneo Infrastructure Partners completed the acquisitions in 2026, records June 2026 entry and sole governance, and lists Cyntox as the single manager-level asset. Cyntox LLC and AdvoWaste Medical Services LLC remain legal carriers and operating brands beneath the combined platform rather than separate PortCos. The exact holdco, fund, vehicle, equity percentage and legal close day are not publicly disclosed. No later add-on, owner change, exit or signed pending transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
